crm_notes:
High-level: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) evaluating Redwood after 3-week Hosted API trial. Interested in migrating to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost. Primary stakeholders: VP Product (Anya Solis), Head of ML (Marcus Kwon), CTO (Ravi Patel).

Trial summary (hosted API):
- Started 2026-02-20, ran until 2026-03-06.
- Purpose: validate production quality for doc search + support assistant; run synthetic loadtests and a small customer-facing A/B.
- Models used: open Llama 2.1 (chat), gemini-like eval for rerank (customer requested comparison vs internal embed reranker).
- Observed p95 token latency: 180ms for short queries (~30 tokens); p99 spikes to ~600ms under burst.
- Avg tokens per request: 140 (mix: 30% short support Qs, 60% doc-search summarization ~200 tokens, 10% long generation ~800 tokens).
- Typical concurrency during normal traffic: 10-15 concurrent requests; peak observed during demo: 80 concurrent.
- QPS (sustained steady): 18 qps; peak burst qps recorded in trial: 120 qps (30s window).
- Cost note: hosted API cost during trial ~ $3.2k; customer expects ~2-3x reduction with Dedicated/quantization/caching.

POC / Evaluation activities:
- 2026-02-23: kickoff (ff_20260225_1402) - scoped DOC search eval and agent routing.
- 2026-03-02: perf deep-dive (ff_20260302_1037) - Diego/RW infra on-call. Collected trace logs + token mix.
- 2026-03-08: security sync requesting SOC2 artifacts + DPA template.
- SE ran prefix caching test showing 40% token reduction for common queries.

Requirements summary (from calls):
- Workloads: doc search ranking + extractive summarization for enterprise docs, in-chat support assistant with function/tool calls to internal APIs.
- Latency SLOs: p95 < 250ms for short queries; p50 < 120ms.
- Throughput: estimate steady-state 15-25 qps, peak bursts to 100-150 qps during product launches.
- Concurrency target: need handling up to 150 concurrent inference slots (for safety).
- Token mix: 60% 200-300 token requests, 30% 20-60 token quick queries, 10% long >500 tokens.
- Data controls: must support SSO (SAML), audit logs, optional customer-managed KMS, and EU data residency for some customers.
- Model preference: open models preferred; willing to adopt quantized variants if accuracy preserved.

Dedicated sizing ask (what LatticeBeam requested):
- Proposed dedicated pool sizing for 3-region setup (NA primary, EU failover): baseline 4x A100 equivalent nodes (est) with burst buffer of 2 nodes. Want latency guarantees during bursts.
- Want cost estimate for monthly reserved vs 12-month commit with burst credits.

Internal notes / SE recommendations (Diego):
- Based on trial metrics and token mix we recommended:
  * Baseline capacity to sustain 25 qps steady with 100 token average => estimate 2x L40 GPUs (quantized) OR 1x higher-capacity instance depending on kernel optimizations.
  * Burst capacity: autoscale to handle 150 qps for 1-2 minute bursts using warm pool of 2 dedicated nodes + routing to hosted fallback.
  * KV/prefix caching expected to reduce token volume ~30-45% on doc search flows; implement caching and cache-warm during launch windows.
  * Concurrency safety: plan for 150 inference slots; request routing to split high-latency long-generation tasks to lower-priority pool.

Open items / blockers:
- Security: DPA edits, KMS integration details, certs for EU region residency.
- Capacity: customer wants clearer QPS->node mapping; asks for a runnable sizing workbook (Diego to deliver 2026-03-12).
- Commercial: CFO wants 3 pricing scenarios (monthly reserved, annual committed, consumption + burst) by EOD 2026-03-15.

Quotes / paraphrases: "We liked the latency during normal queries, but worried about those p99 spikes during demos — need a plan for graceful degradation." — VP Product (Anya).

Next steps:
- 2026-03-12: deliver sizing workbook + node mapping (action: Diego).
- 2026-03-16: commercial proposal (Elena) + legal DPA draft (buyer legal).
- 2026-03-18: final capacity sizing deep-dive (video call) and pilot kickoff on Dedicated (2-week pilot)

Other CRM-style notes:
- Decision process: procurement + legal + infra sign-off; timeline aggressive (target Apr commit).
- Health: warm (engaged), champion in product (Anya) and ML lead (Marcus).
trial_metrics: Sustained: 18 qps; Peak short bursts: 120 qps (30s); Avg tokens/request: 140; Token mix ~ 60% mid, 30% short, 10% long; Typical concurrency: 10-15, demo peak 80; p95 latency ~180ms, p99 spikes to 600ms under burst.
dedicated_sizing_recommendation: Recommended baseline: equivalent of 2 high-capacity quantized GPU instances to cover steady 25 qps with 100-150 token avg. Warm pool of 2 nodes for burst to reach 150 qps. Implement prefix/KV caching to reduce token volume by ~30-45%. Suggest 12-month commit pricing with burst credits for best unit economics. Include fallback routing to hosted API for unexpected overages.
sales_playbook_notes: Mid-market PLG -> sales-assisted motion. Provide sizing workbook, 2-week Dedicated pilot with clear SLA on latency, and 3 commercial scenarios. Emphasize Optimize toolkit (batching + caching) to reach target unit cost. Highlight European residency options for sensitive customers.
final_comments: Strong fit for Dedicated once security items closed. High chance to convert if sizing workbook answers QPS->nodes question and legal moves quickly. Keep close follow-up on DPA and KMS engineering loop.
